label: The New Rhetoric
summary: The manual of rhetoric attributed in the Renaissance to Cicero (in fact pseudo Ciceronian).

claims.statement: Entered as no. 9 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Language, Rhetoric and Grammar. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the new rhetoric".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Rhetorica ad Herennium. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 1st century BC · Printed 1470.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
